description: Read-only fetch of one active published English Nebula blog post as Markdown (full article body). Use this when you need the complete article after nebula_search_blog or nebula_list_knowledge (section "blogs"); use nebula_get_section instead for Answers, case studies, or services. Accepts slug, canonical URL (/post/...), or index from nebula_list_knowledge blogs (0-based). Old or redirected slugs resolve to the current live post (canonicalUrl of the replacement; response includes requestedSlug and redirectedFrom). Retired slugs return a clear retired message. Returns title, slug, canonicalUrl, publisher, datePublished, dateModified, language, excerpt, categories/tags when available, contentMarkdown, contentFormat. Only live published English posts; /ar/ posts return an error. If the JSON exceeds the size cap, contentMarkdown is paginated via contentOffset / nextContentOffset.

contentOffset.description: Character offset into contentMarkdown when continuing a truncated response (default 0)

index.description: 0-based index into nebula_list_knowledge / nebula_get_section blogs (same order as the compact blogs list)

name: nebula_get_blog
title: Get Nebula blog
